captions.head: Every can vanishes
captions.sub: The drink keeps its shape for an instant, then falls.

captions.head: Glass walls fall out
captions.sub: Their frames are aluminium. Every pane drops.

captions.head: Cars sink onto their brakes
captions.sub: Alloy wheels are aluminium. Steel scrapes the road.

captions.head: Sapphires vanish
captions.sub: A sapphire is aluminium oxide. So is a ruby.

captions.head: The ground cracks
captions.sub: Earth's crust is 8% aluminium, locked into rock and concrete.

captions.head: The power goes out
captions.sub: Most long-distance power lines are aluminium.

captions.head: Aluminium is back
captions.sub: Right where it was. The damage stays.

captions.head: Then the tsunami
captions.sub: Weakened seabed slopes slide, and slides make tsunamis.
